clock_hz.source: the clock at which the datasheet's dense peak holds: 989.4 TFLOPS BF16 = 132 SMs x 4096 FLOPs per clock x 1.83 GHz

eta_hbm.source: no trustworthy public value; an unsourced summary gives 2.5-3 TB/s sustained (75-90% of peak). Measure with an HBM copy or triad kernel.

tile.source: one CUTLASS/cuBLAS Hopper tile shape (M x N); level A of the compute model

nvlink_rate.source: GPU-to-GPU about 380 GB/s; NCCL ring bus bandwidth 365-370 GB/s (https://github.com/NVIDIA/nccl-tests/issues/212)

nvls_level.source: 8-GPU NVLS all-reduce about 480 GB/s bus bandwidth against the port bound 2(n-1)/(n+1) x 375 GB/s

nic_rate.source: 400 Gb/s ConnectX-7 x 0.98 payload; ib_write_bw measures 49 GB/s

pcie_rate.source: PCIe Gen5 x16: 63 GB/s x 0.88 packet efficiency; measured 55-56 GB/s

launch_eager_s.source: about 3 us for a null kernel on recent hardware (NVIDIA developer forum)
